name: project-insight
description: Project management and time tracking via Project Insight.
long_description: Project Insight MCP server exposes projects, tasks, timesheets, time entries, rate cards, and users from Project Insight (https://www.projectinsight.com) to AI assistants. Authenticate per-user via SSO device activation by asking the assistant to 'link my Project Insight account', or use a static API token for service accounts. Token-efficient field selection (minimal / summary / standard / full or custom field lists) keeps responses small.

base_url.title: Project Insight API URL
base_url.description: Your Project Insight API base URL, e.g. https://your-tenant.projectinsight.net/api/

api_token.title: API Token (service accounts only — leave blank for SSO)
api_token.description: Most users should leave this blank. The assistant will walk you through SSO sign-in the first time you use a tool. Only fill this in for service accounts or environments without SSO.
